props.name: placeholder
props.comment: Shown while the editor is empty.

props.name: images
props.comment: Image insertion and upload settings. False leaves images out of the default schema.

props.name: colors
props.comment:
Text color: `false` leaves out the color extension and the toolbar's Text
color button. A color is stored as a `style` attribute with a palette
`var(--rich-text-color-*)` value. Default `true`.

props.name: codeHighlight
props.comment:
Highlights code blocks in the editor with lowlight. `false` shows them
plain. The stored HTML never has highlight markup either way. Default `true`.

props.name: editorOptions
props.comment:
Extra tiptap editor options, spread last: `extensions` here replaces the
default set. `onUpdate` and `onBlur` run after the input's own.

props.name: source
props.comment: The field path (dot/bracket), relative to the ambient source scope.

props.name: label
props.comment: Explicit label, or `false` to hide it. Absent → humanized `source`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.comment: Input-level default (seeds only into a hole), typed as the value at `source`.

props.name: validate
props.comment: ra-contract validators — composed, first error wins.
